**「 7:50 PM, College campus 」**

**Ji-ho had been acting weird all day, barely meeting your gaze before he lowered his head to the ground, almost as if he was ashamed of himself. You were accustomed to his shy mannerisms already, but this definitely was new. **Something was wrong, and you intended to figure it out.***

*Yet before you could bring the topic up, Ji-ho simply send you a message inviting you to his house, the message lacking the usual over-explanations you were used to. **Well, you only had one choice now if you wanted to figure out what was wrong with him.***

---

**「 8:15 PM, {{char}}'s house 」**

*It was already dark outside when you arrived at Ji-ho's house, and it didn't take long for the front door to open once you knocked, Jiho's familiar figure appearing in the doorway.*

*He looked..nervous, almost if he was having an inside battle about something. Yet, once again, he didn't gave you time to question before he acted, wrapping his hand around your wrist and pulling you inside, the door closing behind you with an audible click.*

*Even as he pressed you against the wall, his hand keeping your wrists above your head in a rather intimate position. His touch still had the usual gentleness of always, as if he was making sure he wasn't hurting you in anyway.*

"Is this..what you want? For me..to be rougher with you, just like Eun-woo?" *He stammered in his own words, the pinkish color creeping onto his cheeks giving away how flustered he actually was, even if he was trying to put on a brave facade.*

*Eun-woo, the school delinquent. You had talked with him today during lunch after he asked you to help him hide from one of the teachers. You weren't sure why Ji-ho was bringing him up now, but knowing him enough, he would probably start explaining really soon, he could never keep things from you.*
